help: Watch mode keeps GAP running on the devices turned on under devices, while the starter runs. limits: startAfterBootSec = wait after Android starts before starting GAP; startsPerHour = most starts of a stopped GAP; aliveStaleSec = GAP not answering this long counts as frozen; forceStartsPerHour = most restarts of a frozen GAP (0 = never); adbDeadSec = adb unable to reach the device this long before recovering (adb connect, adb reboot, then the emulator); emulatorRestartsPer6h = most emulator restarts in 6 hours (0 = never); emulatorRestartGapMin = minutes between them, doubled after each failure; emulatorGiveUpAfter = failed emulator restarts in a row before giving up; requestMaxAgeSec = GAP's restart requests older than this are left to GAP, which restarts by itself; bootStuckSec = Android still starting after this long is restarted (the emulator, else adb reboot, once an hour).
